definitions: 发酵；指微生物（如酵母）分解糖类并产生酒精、酸或气体等物质的过程。

examples.text: As the yeasts feed on the fruit sugars they produce a compound called ethanol— the type of alcohol in alcoholic beverages. This process is called fermentation. Nobody knows exactly when humans began to create fermented beverages.
examples.explanation: 这里 fermentation 指“发酵”过程：酵母以水果中的糖为食，产生乙醇，也就是酒精饮料中的酒精成分。

source.text: A brief history of alcohol - Rod Phillips

relations.reason: 例句明确说明酵母分解糖会产生 ethanol，而这个过程叫 fermentation；两者是“产物—过程”的核心关系。
